subject: [hw] DONE K01 rev 3
body:
Rev 3 is host-test coverage only; the driver, the ABI and the K02 hook are unchanged (IK's 0299 embeds the same driver sha256 b57f87f9...aa98; the integrated compile still passes).

Added in kern/test_k01:
- a stuck larb7 port makes n2j_bus() fail: the ioctl answers EIO/RWJ_E_BUS, the domain is powered off again, no encoder start;
- a failed mapping of the 40 MiB claim answers EIO/RWJ_E_BUS with no register access and retries on the next call;
- (from rev 2) the 4096x3072 NV12 maximum picture, the dst_capacity boundary, the chroma-address wrap.

Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k01/run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST K01 PASS 822/822 (violations 0)
(ASan+UBSan, -O2 and TSan; 822 checks each, violations 0)

Still not done: phone run, 4032x3024 hardware limit/strips, EXIF/restart output semantics, YUYV near-24 MiB, VEN interleaving on hardware; full list in dsh-state/workers/K01/STATUS.md.
